ixfwms data model

25 tables. The middle of the model is simple: an item says what a thing is, a place says where, and stock connects them in one of two ways.

Drawn from apps/server/src/db/schema.ts, through migration 0025_place_hints. Regenerate with npm run docs:data-model.

The core

Things attached to other things

Rules the arrows don't show

Codes share one namespace. Every code on places, items and units is claimed in the codes table by database triggers (migration 0013). A retired code is never reused, and forward_to sends scans of a merged item's old code to the item it became.

The place tree is stored twice. parent_id is the tree and path holds the ids from the root (/a/b/c/). Search and "everything inside" read path with a prefix match, so a move has to rewrite it for the whole subtree.

Places do several jobs. locations.kind and the type's flags make a row a normal place, someone's carry list (owner_user_id), the "Out of the lab" place, or a build.

History has no location constraints on purpose. The ~ location columns in movements and logs stay readable after a place is deleted.

Who did what

Users are left out of the diagrams because nearly every table points at them. These are the links. Two go the other way too: users.home_location_id is a person's default location, and locations.owner_user_id makes a place someone's carry list.
